idea-plugin.description:
MCP server for TestFly & Selenium WebDriver browser automation.

Lets JetBrains AI Assistant control a real browser — 88 tools for navigation, element interactions, assertions, self-healing locators, and framework-native test code generation.

  • TestFly native Page Object (BasePage), TestNG (BaseTest), JUnit 5 (BaseJUnit5Test), and Cucumber (BaseCucumberSteps / BaseCucumberTest) codegen
  • detect_testfly, generate_testfly_config, and generate_testfly_pom tools
  • Accessibility-first locators (getByRole, getByLabel, getByTestId, find) and web-first auto-waiting assertThat assertions
  • Python pytest and C# NUnit codegen
  • GitHub Actions / Jenkins / GitLab CI pipeline generation
  • Playwright migration hints
  • No ChromeDriver setup — browser auto-starts on first use

Requires: pip install testfly-mcp and Python 3.10+

GitHub | PyPI | Docs
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 1.0.0: Full TestFly v1.0.0 framework alignment. Native io.testfly.* codegen across Page Object (BasePage), TestNG (BaseTest), JUnit 5 (BaseJUnit5Test), and Cucumber (BaseCucumberSteps + BaseCucumberTest runner). 88 tools including detect_testfly, generate_testfly_config, and generate_testfly_pom. Added Initialize testfly.yml and Diagnostics actions.
  • 0.4.1: fill_form now captures accessibility attributes, so the a11y-first getByLabel / getByRole locators are generated by default no matter how a form is filled.
  • 0.4.0: Framework-native Selenium Boot codegen — accessibility-first locators (getByRole / getByLabel / getByTestId) and web-first assertThat assertions across TestNG, JUnit 5, Page Object and Cucumber; new detect_selenium_boot tool; SmartLocator fallback; 85 tools.
